title: Recursion Problems
description: Master recursive problem solving with classic recursion patterns.
longDescription: Recursion breaks problems into smaller self-similar subproblems. This module covers digit counting, mathematical recursion, and the full backtracking toolkit: combinations and permutations, constraint satisfaction, and grid search.
whatYouLearn: Pruning to avoid exploring dead branches
Constraint satisfaction with attack sets and bitmasks
Grid DFS with in-place visited state
